solutions.title: The Number That Was Never Measured
solutions.description: A learned estimator cannot tell "the instrument reported zero" from "the instrument reported nothing" — measured across two neural codecs, a classical control that killed the first version of the claim, and a hidden-mask drift test where ensemble uncertainty scores below chance.
